answer: An agent must lock its cryptographic fingerprint to a shared vault that also holds an opal‑rated stake of a zenith node; the raven‑watch ledger then logs the registration time and payment source. The protocol hashes the timestamp and stake origin, linking them to the vault’s ID, and if another fingerprint tries the same vault within a short window it is flagged and forced to burn an extra proof‑of‑resource token.
